summary.text: Danilo Burgos is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 197, which he has represented since December 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Burgos graduated from Olney High School in 1997.
His professional experience includes working as an employee of Philadelphia Councilwoman Maria Quiñones Sánchez.
Burgos assumed office in the House on December 1, 2018, succeeding Emilio Vazquez.
